title: Fig and American Cheese Pasta Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with sweet figs, creamy American cheese, and oozing goodness. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped figs and stir-fry for 2 minutes until they start to soften.
Add soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Add cooked pasta and shredded American cheese to the skillet. Stir-fry until cheese is melted and pasta is well coated.
Transfer pasta to a serving dish and garnish with additional figs if desired.
